notes.title: 1.1.3 update
notes.content: this update just fixes a problem with the "Grand Sam" achievement, which is for getting to the end of the credits segment without letting Sam get hit. Previous version still gave you this achievement if you hit the start button to skip the credits. Whoops!

notes.title: 1.1.1 update
notes.content: 1.1.1 update add leaderboard access without the requirement for 1cc, but no longer allows leaderboard access if playing with more generous starting resources than default from the game options menu.
